*Mentor: [Prof. Srikant Srinivasan](https://plaksha.edu.in/faculty-details/dr-srikant-srinivasan), Plaksha University.*

Engineered a custom 16-bit, 44.1kHz digital effects pedal for the guitar from scratch, alongside an enclosure and full UI interface.

- Designed single-supply biasing op-amp circuits for pickup signal level and impedance matching with the downstream ADC.
- Implemented real-time, low-latency audio processing on the Teensy 4.1, including a 10-stage tone stack, distortion, delay, reverb, and more.
